WEATHER & SEASONS WORKSHEETS · AGES 4–5

Weather, Seasons & What We Wear worksheets — printables for little hands.

Thirty-five genuine activity sheets about the sky, the seasons and the clothes they ask for: match, circle, count, order the water cycle, read a map, chart a week of weather and trace every big word. Download the original sheet, print it, or solve every sheet on screen in Class 34 first.
